title: Wyatt and Olivia Hall Wedding!
summary: Celebrate with Wyatt and Olivia Beck!
content:
We had the joy of celebrating with Wyatt and Olivia on October 2, 2026, as they were joined together in marriage and began their life together as one. It was a beautiful day filled with love, joy, and wonderful memories shared with family and friends.

As we celebrate this new chapter in their lives, we give thanks to God for the gift of marriage and for the blessing of bringing Wyatt and Olivia together. We pray that the Lord will guide and strengthen them throughout their marriage, keeping them steadfast in faith and reminding them of His love and grace each day.

Here are a few photos from their special day. Please join us in congratulating Wyatt and Olivia and praying for many years of love, faith, joy, and God’s abundant blessings as they continue their life together in Christ.![](/images/Screenshot-2026-10-07-113651.png)![](/images/Screenshot-2026-10-07-113431.png)![](/images/Screenshot-2026-10-07-113616.png)
